# few-shot-selector

> Select few-shot examples by similarity and diversity with maximal marginal relevance, a deterministic hashing embedder, token budgets and duplicate suppression Python package `trysac-few-shot-selector`, import name `few_shot_selector`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
